verses.text: But concerning the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that aught be written unto you.

segments.text: But concerning the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that aught be written unto you.

verses.text: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.

segments.text: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.

verses.text: When they are saying, Peace and safety, then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall in no wise escape.

segments.text: When they are saying, Peace and safety, then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall in no wise escape.

verses.text: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief:

segments.text: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief:

verses.text: for ye are all sons of light, and sons of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness;

segments.text: for ye are all sons of light, and sons of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness;

verses.text: so then let us not sleep, as do the rest, but let us watch and be sober.

segments.text: so then let us not sleep, as do the rest, but let us watch and be sober.

verses.text: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that are drunken are drunken in the night.

segments.text: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that are drunken are drunken in the night.

verses.text: But let us, since we are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.

segments.text: But let us, since we are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.

verses.text: For God appointed us not unto wrath, but unto the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

segments.text: For God appointed us not unto wrath, but unto the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

verses.text: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

segments.text: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

verses.text: Wherefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as also ye do.

segments.text: Wherefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as also ye do.

verses.text: But we beseech you, brethren, to know them that labor among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;

segments.text: But we beseech you, brethren, to know them that labor among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;

verses.text: and to esteem them exceeding highly in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.

segments.text: and to esteem them exceeding highly in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.

verses.text: And we exhort you, brethren, admonish the disorderly, encourage the fainthearted, support the weak, be longsuffering toward all.

segments.text: And we exhort you, brethren, admonish the disorderly, encourage the fainthearted, support the weak, be longsuffering toward all.

verses.text: See that none render unto any one evil for evil; but always follow after that which is good, one toward another, and toward all.

segments.text: See that none render unto any one evil for evil; but always follow after that which is good, one toward another, and toward all.

verses.text: Rejoice always;

segments.text: Rejoice always;

verses.text: pray without ceasing;

segments.text: pray without ceasing;

verses.text: in everything give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus to you-ward.

segments.text: in everything give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus to you-ward.

verses.text: Quench not the Spirit;

segments.text: Quench not the Spirit;

verses.text: despise not prophesyings;

segments.text: despise not prophesyings;

verses.text: prove all things; hold fast that which is good;

segments.text: prove all things; hold fast that which is good;

verses.text: abstain from every form of evil.

segments.text: abstain from every form of evil.

verses.text: And the God of peace himself sanctify you wholly; and may your spirit and soul and body be preserved entire, without blame at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

segments.text: And the God of peace himself sanctify you wholly; and may your spirit and soul and body be preserved entire, without blame at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.text: Faithful is he that calleth you, who will also do it.

segments.text: Faithful is he that calleth you, who will also do it.

verses.text: Brethren, pray for us.

segments.text: Brethren, pray for us.

verses.text: Salute all the brethren with a holy kiss.

segments.text: Salute all the brethren with a holy kiss.

verses.text: I adjure you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the brethren.

segments.text: I adjure you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the brethren.

verses.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

segments.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
